title: WeirdCraft - ChatGPT's Version of Minecraft
description: This project was made with GPT 5.5 and with the prompt, "Create a minecraft resource pack that changes the texture of every item and block to your wierd ahh perspective of minecraft. for 1.21.x"
body:
This mod shows that even ChatGPT can create a resource pack. It will be almost impossible to play the game, but hey, it's your decision.

This resource pack made by ChatGPT changed 116 textures to make it unplayable. This includes glitch textures for blocks, glitch textures for items, and- oh wait. This just in. There is nothing else but glitch textures. Well, knock yourself out with this texture pack.

                      ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
